agent_auth.summary: No account, no API key, no OAuth, no signup. Free instruments answer anonymous requests; paid instruments are paid for at the moment of the call with a signed x402 payment. There is nothing to apply for and nobody to ask.

anonymous.description: Free doors take no credential at all. Paid doors take a signed x402 v2 payment, which authenticates nothing about who you are and does not need to: it settles the one call it paid for and is good for that call only.

agent_auth.why_no_endpoints: register_uri, claim_uri and revocation_uri are null rather than pointed somewhere plausible. No credential is issued here, so there is nothing to register for, claim, or revoke — and a discovery URI that resolves to nothing is the stale-metadata failure this spec exists to prevent. When there is nothing to advertise, the honest advertisement is nothing.

tiers.summary: The free instruments: no credential of any kind

tiers.credential: a signed x402 v2 payment in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
tiers.summary: The paid instruments: pay for the call, at the call
The back office: HTTP Basic, and it is not for you
